title: Read a typed error body
prompt: Create `src/pets.ts` that exports `async function createPetChecked(client: Client<paths>, input: NewPet): Promise<{ ok: true; pet: Pet } | { ok: false; invalidFields: string[] }>` (`Pet` and `NewPet` are the generated schemas). It calls `POST /pets`. On a 400 validation error it returns the `name`s of the invalid fields from the error body. It throws an `Error` on any other failure.
